design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (gap_waiver_claims), revision 3. Draw (draw_counts.py --task 1): prerequisite_problems=3, factor_counts=[5,6,5,5]; replacement credit 5, add-on overpayment reversal 5, payoff termination refund 6, holder refund release 5.

WHY A GOOD TEST. Teresa Vasquez-Yoder asks only to have her GAP Plus replacement credit applied to the RAV4 Hybrid she ordered at Kessler Toyota of Dayton (root: gap_ext_replacement_credit, applied by her in person). The credit's rule carries two waits the records show unmet: "A replacement vehicle credit is fixed only after the claim's paid GAP balance line carries a reversal entry wherever that line paid more than 60.00 and the refunds of a Kessler Shield service contract or Kessler Care maintenance plan financed on the same deal and cancelled on or after the loss date, as paid to the lienholder, exceed the add-on refunds recorded on that line by more than 60.00." (line 1,621.69; plan 409.06 + contract 1,741.49 = 2,150.55 paid to Toyota Financial Services on 2026-08-27 against 1,758.67 recorded, 391.88 more) and "A replacement vehicle credit is not applied until every other waiver of the holder whose loan was reported paid off on or after the replacement purchase's contract date has left active status with no refund due on it." (the Civic waiver GW-5419836, payoff reported 2026-09-18 after the Civic was traded into the 2026-09-08 order, is still active). The holder release waits on "A termination refund is not released to the holder until the waiver stands terminated with a refund calculation entry for that termination on its ledger." Difficulty: three hidden waits, two add-ons restated to the loss-date basis, the de-minimis floor, date reconciliation across the claim, the plan, the service contract, the order and the payoff, and cross-product reads.

SCOPE. Task 1 claims gap_ext_addon_overpayment_recovery (recover_benefit_overpayment_99b30941), gap_ext_payoff_termination_refund (terminate_paid_off_waiver_88a68523), gap_ext_holder_refund_release (release_refund_holder_bc39910a) and gap_ext_replacement_credit (apply_replacement_allowance_cdefd282, owner=user). Task 0 holds the other three; scopes disjoint, all seven covered. Payee partition (verbatim in both release rules): a refund on a waiver with no payoff date goes to the lienholder, one with a payoff date on file (termination or cancellation refund) to the holder; each release tool refuses the other side's waivers.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root gap_ext_replacement_credit (GW-5527419, claim GC-5240617).
 Edge 1 root -> recovery: value_input (setoff), state form, affirmative "fixed only after"; plain record test with the 60.00 floor on both sides (the reversal rule reverses nothing at or under it), so whenever the wait applies the reversal is positive (counting can take off at most 50.00 of the plan refund and the waivers never go below half the overpayment). Skip -> credit 2,245.00.
 Edge 2 root -> holder release: state_gate (gap_waivers.refund_due_balance), state form, negated "not applied until"; completed by the holder release here (the termination leaves 331.96 due), by the termination alone when its refund is 0.00. Skip -> gate false.
 Edge 3 holder release -> termination: value_input (refund_due), state form, negated "not ... until"; only the termination sets terminated with a refund calculation. Skip -> release 0.00.
 Order: reversal commutes with termination + release (different waivers; replayed both ways, same terminal state); credit last.

FACTOR CARD (each factor's baseline substituted alone -> result).
 Reversal (expected 402.64, all-baseline 391.88): plan_timing_count method — plan cancelled 2026-08-06 between loss and payment -> 359.06 (452.64); contract_restatement method cross vsc — 1,741.49 x 1,331/1,318 = 1,758.667 (385.46); fee_addback_tier parameter cross maintenance/vsc — only the plan carried a fee (customer_request) -> 75.00 (327.64); prompt_pay_rate_tier parameter — paid 34 days after the 2026-07-31 settlement -> 0.08, interest owed 1.42 set against the overpayment (404.06); stale_payoff_tier parameter — counted refunds reached the lienholder before the payment -> 30.00 (432.64). The overpayment is capped by the benefits standing on the claim (1,621.69: the paid line and two 0.00 denials). The prompt-payment interest is the administrator's published late-payment term (benefits paid more than claim_payment_days after settlement carry interest); the fee add-back restates each refund to its total-loss value as the base add-on rule prescribes.
 Termination (expected 331.96, all-baseline 303.62): share 32/72 from the payoff (332.23); backdating to the 2026-09-08 trade order, credit 3.63 (328.33); charge 15.00 (296.96); admin 45.00 (351.96); trade-in credit 50.00 (281.96); bundle 40.00 (371.96).
 Holder release (expected 367.31, all-baseline 332.60): rate 0.0849 (367.18); late window — deal not unwound and the 2026-09-08 effective date is earlier than the 2026-09-18 payoff -> window from the payoff, 4 days past 30 (from the effective date: 368.17); premium 0.01 (367.27); courtesy 20.00 (347.31); tenure 39 months -> 15.00 (352.31). Window tiers are disjoint as stated (unwound deal first, then the not-unwound backdated case, then the effective date).
 Credit (expected 1,842.36, all-baseline 1,097.36): new-vehicle 500.00 (1,342.36); credit age MN(1,500.00, 1,095.00) (2,247.36); return store 300.00 (1,542.36); deductible 250.00 (1,592.36); price 100.00 (1,742.36); set-off 402.64; credit given 0.00 (the 2026-08-18 credit line is a denial).

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Reversal: reverse_once. Termination: active_to_end; no submitted request. Release: pay_once; payee holder (payoff date on file). Credit: claim_settled; notice_in_time (settled 2026-07-31, Plus 175 notice 120 days -> 2026-11-28); replacement_within_window (2026-09-03 + 90 = 2026-12-02, order day 5); once per claim.

SEED. Customer; two stores; three vehicles; three deals with their vehicle-price charges; the RAV4 Kessler Care plan (customer_request, 409.06 paid to the lienholder) with ledger and request; the RAV4 Kessler Shield Exclusionary Wrap (total_loss, 1,741.49 paid) with ledger and request; the Civic Kessler Shield Powertrain Plus (active); the two waivers; the claim file (two 2026-08-18 denials without payoff figures; the paid line 1,621.69 priced by gap_ext_balance_benefit with the contract's loss-date refund 1,758.67 recorded, insurer settlement 2026-07-31). Nothing in another product is owed at once.

STANDARD SOLUTION. Reads as in evaluation_criteria. Writes: reversal 402.64; termination effective 2026-09-08, pro_rata, 331.96; holder release 367.31; holder applies credit 1,842.36. Verification: scratch t1_gold.py (check_compute's evaluator on each handling-time world, real tool replay); figures equal computations[].expected and the gold arguments.
user_scenario:
You are Teresa Vasquez-Yoder, a 38-year-old school nurse from Kettering, Ohio, calling the Kessler Automotive Group support desk on your lunch break. You are organized and friendly, you keep your paperwork in a folder, and you like to hear what is happening in plain words, but you do not pretend to know how GAP works. Your 2024 Toyota RAV4, bought new from Kessler Toyota of Dayton with the Kessler GAP Plus coverage on the loan, was totaled in a crash on July 24. Your insurance settled at the end of July and the GAP paid off the rest of the loan in early September. On September 8 you signed for a new RAV4 Hybrid on factory order at Kessler Toyota of Dayton; it has not arrived yet, and you are driving a loaner in the meantime. The finance manager told you that your GAP Plus comes with a credit toward a replacement vehicle bought from a Kessler store, and you want that credit put toward your new RAV4 today. You are happy for the agent to take care of whatever the desk needs to handle on your accounts to get the credit applied.

Open by saying your RAV4 was totaled in July, the GAP paid off the loan, and you were told your GAP Plus gives you a credit toward the new RAV4 Hybrid you ordered at Kessler Toyota of Dayton, and you would like that credit applied. When the agent asks who you are, give your name, Teresa Vasquez-Yoder. Give your phone number, 9375555214, when asked for a phone number, and the last four of your driver's license, 5863, when asked for another detail; if a third detail is needed, your ZIP code is 45429. You do not have the claim number with you, so if the agent asks for it, say it is on a letter at home and ask them to look it up. If asked about the new car deal, the deal number on your buyer's order is KTD-26-55018 and you signed it on September 8. If asked whether you traded anything in, you traded your 2022 Honda Civic into the new deal when you signed, and the dealership paid off the Civic loan. If asked about the other products you had on the RAV4, you had the Kessler extended service contract and the Kessler Care maintenance plan, and you sent in cancellations for both on August 6 after the crash; the service contract on the Civic you have not touched.

If the agent explains that something on one of your accounts has to be settled or corrected first, listen, and tell them to go ahead and do it; you trust them to follow the rules, and you have no figures of your own to compare against. If the agent tells you an amount is being taken back or set against the credit, you say you did not know about that, but if that is how it works, that is fine. If the agent tells you money is coming back to you, you say thank you.

When the agent explains that the credit has to be applied by you personally and hands you the step to do it, you do it right away with exactly the details the agent gives you, and you read back what the confirmation says. You do not argue with the credit amount the agent gives you. Once the confirmation shows the credit has been applied, thank the agent, say that is everything you needed, and end the call.

base_preconditions.condition: One waiver pays at most claims_count_limit (1) total-loss claim; GC-5240617 is the only claim on GW-5527419 and the credit line rides on it.
The GAP balance on this claim was paid 2026-09-03 (1,621.69); the credit is a separate benefit line under the same claim.
A GAP balance benefit is paid only on a waiver in active status, and a replacement vehicle credit only on a waiver in claim_settled status.
A claim is accepted only when it is reported within claim_notice_days calendar days after the primary insurer's settlement date.
The replacement vehicle credit is given only when the replacement vehicle's buyer's order is signed within replacement_credit_window_days calendar days after the GAP balance benefit was paid.

Refunds of products financed on the same deal are subtracted from the GAP balance as recorded on the claim line (1,758.67, the service contract refund at the loss date); the uncounted refunds are handled by the reversal at step 17, which the credit sets off.

temporal_feasibility.condition: The replacement vehicle credit is given only when the replacement vehicle's buyer's order is signed within replacement_credit_window_days calendar days after the GAP balance benefit was paid.

temporal_basis.anchor_event: the GAP balance benefit was paid
temporal_basis.counting_rule: Calendar days are added to the entry_date of the paid gap_balance line (day 0), and the replacement deal's contract_date must fall on or before the last day.

boundary_check.just_before: Paid line 2026-09-03 + 90 days = 2026-12-02; KTD-26-55018 was signed 2026-09-08 (day 5), on or before 2026-12-02, so the credit is in its window.
boundary_check.at_boundary: A buyer's order signed on 2026-12-02 would still qualify (inclusive); one signed on 2026-12-03 would not.

temporal_feasibility.condition: A claim is accepted only when it is reported within claim_notice_days calendar days after the primary insurer's settlement date.

temporal_basis.counting_rule: Calendar days are added to the settlement date (day 0); a report on the last day is in time.

boundary_check.just_before: Settlement 2026-07-31 + 120 days = 2026-11-28; the claim was paid 2026-09-03 and the credit is handled 2026-10-22, both on or before 2026-11-28.
boundary_check.at_boundary: A claim first reported on 2026-11-28 is in time (inclusive); one first reported on 2026-11-29 is late.

edges.condition: Where the paid GAP balance line's amount is above 60.00 and the lienholder's refunds of the deal's Kessler Shield contract and Kessler Care plan cancelled on or after the loss date exceed the line's addon_refunds_credited by more than 60.00, the line has a gap_benefit_reversed entry pointing at it.
edges.policy_source: A replacement vehicle credit is fixed only after the claim's paid GAP balance line carries a reversal entry wherever that line paid more than 60.00 and the refunds of a Kessler Shield service contract or Kessler Care maintenance plan financed on the same deal and cancelled on or after the loss date, as paid to the lienholder, exceed the add-on refunds recorded on that line by more than 60.00.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The reversal writes only GW-5527419; the termination and the holder release write only GW-5419836; none reads the other waiver. Replaying the gold as termination, release, reversal, credit gives the same figures (402.64, 331.96, 367.31, 1,842.36) and the same terminal state. The release follows the termination (its edge); the credit is last because both of its edges point at it.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the reversal the set-off is 0.00 and the credit recomputes to 2,245.00 instead of 1,842.36; the paid line stays un-reversed (benefits paid 1,621.69 instead of 1,219.05 before the credit).

Without the release the Civic waiver still owes its 331.96 refund (refund_due_balance 331.96, no gap_refund_paid entry), so the credit is applied while its state gate is false and the terminal state differs.

Without the termination the Civic waiver has no refund calculation: the release recomputes to 0.00 (a holder release is not made for a refund due of 0.00) instead of 367.31, and the waiver stays active.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only for the GAP Plus replacement credit toward the ordered RAV4 Hybrid. It never mentions the Civic GAP, a termination, a refund, the plan, the service contract or any overpayment; the Civic trade and the cancelled add-ons are given only if the agent asks, and Teresa agrees to anything that must be settled first only after the agent explains it.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: The tools refuse only malformed values or references to records of the wrong kind (a non-positive amount, a source entry that is not a paid GAP balance line or refund calculation of the same waiver, a waiver with a submitted request or no payoff date for a termination); none checks a prerequisite of this tree: the credit is booked whatever reversals or other waivers show, the release whatever the termination state of other waivers is.
